I will keep my farm simple and steady this year. I am old, I know this land, and I do not want to gamble with complicated changes. Because I have well irrigation and long experience with the wheat-maize system, I will keep most of my land in that rotation and leave a smaller part for cotton. Wheat and maize are the backbone for my farm, and they fit my habits, labor situation, and water conditions. Since some family members work off-farm, I will choose seed and field management that are reliable and not too labor-heavy. I will use improved seed for wheat, hybrid seed for maize, and improved cotton seed so I can get stable emergence and better yield. I will use moderate fertilizer, irrigate when the crop most needs water, and not spray more times than necessary. For tillage, I will use rotary tillage on wheat and cotton land because that is manageable for me, and I will use no-tillage for summer maize after wheat to save time and catch the season. I am aiming for stable production, not the highest possible output.
